# RepoGrant — Part B: tool defaults matrix

*Generated by repogrant 0.1.0 (report schema 1.0). Deterministic; regenerate with `repogrant defaults --md`.*

**Scenario.** A freshly cloned repository with NO agent config of any kind; a developer opens it in each tool with that tool's out-of-box settings.

Each cell is what the tool grants **with no repo config**, on each authority dimension, traceable to a verbatim primary-source quote. `not-judgeable` cells are undetermined *by the documented record* — recorded, never guessed.

## command_execution

| Tool | Default | Consent | Source quote |
|------|---------|---------|--------------|
| Claude Code | consent-required | per-call | "Prompts before most edits, shell commands, and network requests." — <https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions> |
| OpenAI Codex CLI | consent-required  _(branches — version-controlled: on-request (Auto / workspace-write); non-version-controlled: read-only (no command run without approval); conflict (sandboxing page): workspace-write called the default low-friction mode)_ | per-call | "Version-controlled folders: `Auto` (workspace write + on-request approvals)" — <https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/agent-approvals-security> |
| Cursor | not-judgeable | — | _not-judgeable: Cursor's effective default depends on the user's global Run Mode selection (Cursor Settings), which is not a repo-side artifact._ |
| GitHub Copilot | not-judgeable | — | _not-judgeable: Copilot's command authority is platform/runner-side, not a repo grammar (D-02); Copilot is treated as R3 instruction-divergence only._ |
| Gemini CLI | consent-required | per-call | "'default' prompts for approval, 'auto_edit' auto-approves edit tools, and 'plan' is read-only mode." — <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/main/docs/reference/configuration.md> |

| Tool | Default | Consent | Source quote |
|------|---------|---------|--------------|
| Claude Code | none | — | "Claude Code checks workspace trust before it runs any hook from a settings file." — <https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks> |
| OpenAI Codex CLI | none | — | "Non-managed hooks must be reviewed and trusted before they run." — <https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks.md> |
| Cursor | ask (MCP) | per-call | "Cursor asks for approval before using MCP tools by default." — <https://cursor.com/docs/context/mcp> |
| GitHub Copilot | none | — | "" — <https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/use-copilot-agents/coding-agent/customize-the-agent-firewall> |
| Gemini CLI | none | — | "When `true`, bypasses all tool call confirmations for this server (default: `false`)" — <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/main/docs/cli/trusted-folders.md> |

---

**Reading the trap (R4).** The cells that are *not* empty for a silent repo are the defaults trap: a cloned repo with nothing configured still grants these. Notably, Gemini honors a repo's `.gemini/` config and `.env` by default (Folder Trust off), and Codex in a version-controlled folder defaults to `workspace-write` rather than read-only.
